# Lower your storage and compute bill

Use the sections below when you want cheaper storage (compression, tiers, retention), lighter compute (sizing and usage), or {C.CLOUD_LONG} billing context.

## I want to reduce…

- Reduce storage costs with compression
- Use [tiered storage](/learn/data-lifecycle/storage/about-storage-tiers) for cold data
- Configure appropriate retention policies

## Compute costs

- Right-size your instance
- Monitor resource usage
